name: Moneytree MCP
description: Lets ChatGPT and Claude read a Moneytree user's bank, card, points and investment accounts, transactions and spending insights in Japan, read-only.

skills.name: List Accounts and Balances
skills.description: Lists the user's connected bank, card and points accounts and their current balances across institutions.

skills.name: List Transactions
skills.description: Retrieves transaction history with categories so the assistant can answer questions like monthly spend at convenience stores.

skills.name: List Investments
skills.description: Returns investment account balances and holdings so the assistant can analyze the user's portfolio.

skills.name: Flag Unusual Transactions
skills.description: Lists transactions Moneytree marks as unusual so the user can spot unexpected charges.

skills.name: Utility Bill Insights
skills.description: Returns Moneytree's insights on utility bills so the assistant can explain spending trends and ways to save.
